deadlines.quote: Applicants should refer to the solicitation notice for due dates.

contingency, percent of the grant request

award.quote: The maximum award for an individual project is $500,000. The minimum award is $25,000.

sections.name: The Project
sections.quote: 1. Describe the discrete project the grant would fund. The information provided should include grant deliverables and support the cost estimate submitted with the proposal.

sections.quote: 1. How many youth will be served by the project funded with the grant and across what time period?

sections.quote: 11. Describe any youth leadership opportunities during project development and/or implementation.

format.quote: If a question does not apply to the project, indicate "Not Applicable" with a brief explanation. Do not leave blank fields.

eligibility.item: Eligible applicants: local, state, and federal agencies; nonprofit organizations; and federally recognized Native American tribes
eligibility.quote: Eligible applicants include local, state, and federal agencies; nonprofit organizations; and federally recognized Native American tribes.

eligibility.item: Nonprofits must be 501(c)(3) public benefit corporations formed under California Nonprofit Corporation Law, incorporated at least two years, and qualified to do business in California
eligibility.quote: incorporated for a minimum of two years, qualified to do business in California, and qualified as a tax-exempt 501(c)(3) organization under the US Internal Revenue Code.

eligibility.item: Nonprofits must be active with the California Secretary of State and current with the Attorney General Registry of Charities and Fundraisers
eligibility.quote: all nonprofit organizations must be active with the California Secretary of State and current with the registration and reporting requirements of the California Department of Justice

eligibility.item: A fiscal sponsor may apply for a nonprofit that is not a qualified 501(c)(3), but the fiscal sponsor must be the applicant
eligibility.quote: A fiscal sponsor may apply on behalf of a nonprofit that is not a qualified 501(c)(3) organization, but the fiscal sponsor, not the nonprofit, must be the grant applicant.

eligibility.item: Projects must serve youth (birth to 26 years old)
eligibility.quote: Projects must serve youth. For the purposes of this program, youth is defined as a person between the ages of birth and 26 years old.

eligibility.item: Projects must directly support youth access to natural or cultural resources
eligibility.quote: Projects must directly support youth access to either natural or cultural resources.

eligibility.item: Projects must include design features and program elements promoting youth health, safety, well-being, and comfort
eligibility.quote: Projects must include design features and program elements to promote youth health, safety, well-being, and comfort.

eligibility.item: At least 80% of youth participants must be from low-income communities/households AND from underserved communities of color or vulnerable populations
eligibility.quote: At least eighty percent (80%) of the youth participants must meet the criteria for low- income and underserved and vulnerable communities.

eligibility.item: Development projects must have at least 80% of the project footprint in a low-income community
eligibility.quote: If the project is a Development project (see definition in Appendix O), 80% or more of the project's footprint must be located in the low-income community.

eligibility.item: Projects must comply with all labor laws; Development Projects must also comply with CEQA
eligibility.quote: Projects must comply with all labor laws. In addition, Development Projects (see Appendix O for definition) must comply with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)

eligibility.item: Each Project Proposal may include only one project (an applicant may submit more than one proposal)
eligibility.quote: Project Proposals that include more than one project (however, more than one Project Proposal can be submitted by an applicant)

eligibility.item: Development Projects may not be contingent on a future land acquisition
eligibility.quote: Development Projects contingent on a future land acquisition for project implementation

eligibility.item: The applicant may not subgrant or regrant to another entity to implement the project
eligibility.quote: Projects where applicant intends to subgrant or regrant to another entity to implement the project

eligibility.item: Vehicle acquisitions must be clean vehicles primarily dedicated to transporting youth to natural or cultural resources
eligibility.quote: Acquisitions of eco-friendly or clean vehicles that are not primarily dedicated to transporting youth on excursions to natural or cultural resources

eligibility.item: Individuals who helped plan or set priorities for this solicitation, beyond public comment, are ineligible to receive or benefit from its funds
eligibility.quote: Any individual who has participated in planning or setting priorities for a specific solicitation over and above the public comment process

requiredDocuments.item: Project Proposal Signature Page, signed by the Authorized Representative named in the resolution or certification letter
requiredDocuments.quote: Proposal Form Signature Page - The signature page of the completed Project Proposal Form should be electronically signed (See Appendix B).

requiredDocuments.item: Project Proposal Questions Form with responses to all questions
requiredDocuments.quote: Project Proposal Questions Form - The Project Proposal Questions Form contains the project proposal questions and a space for responses.

requiredDocuments.item: Low-Income Community Documentation (Outdoor Equity Fact Finder map, DWR mapping tool map, or other evidence)
requiredDocuments.quote: Low-Income Community Documentation - Provide evidence the project meets the low-income community eligibility requirement. Submit at least one of the following:

requiredDocuments.item: Cost Estimate with grant-funded and other-funded costs in separate columns (Appendix D format)
requiredDocuments.quote: Cost Estimate - Provide a cost estimate reflecting all costs associated with the project. Identify costs to be funded by the grant and costs covered by other funding sources in separate columns.
Nonprofit Questionnaire - Nonprofit applicants provide a completed questionnaire. (See Appendix F).

requiredDocuments.item: Supporting Documentation, up to eight pages (brochures, curriculum samples, workplans, logic models, photos, etc.)
requiredDocuments.quote: Supporting Documentation - Submit up to eight pages of documentation that helps illustrate and support the proposed project
Site Plan - Submit a drawing or schematic of the proposed changes to land or structures to support youth access to natural or cultural resources

requiredDocuments.item: Signed Authorizing Resolution (Appendix G) or Certification Letter (Appendix H) (Step Three, qualifying projects only)
requiredDocuments.quote: Signed Authorizing Resolution or Certification Letter - Provide a signed authorizing resolution from the applicant's governing board.

requiredDocuments.item: Nonprofit eligibility evidence: IRS 501(c)(3) determination, Secretary of State Active status, and AG Registry Current status (Step Three)
requiredDocuments.quote: Eligibility for Nonprofit Applicants - Provide evidence:

requiredDocuments.item: Timeline of major project milestones (Step Three)
requiredDocuments.quote: Timeline - Provide an estimated timeline for major project milestones.

requiredDocuments.item: Assurance Statement signed by the Authorized Representative on the 80% youth requirement, plus clean vehicle use if applicable (Step Three)
requiredDocuments.quote: Assurance Statement - Provide a statement signed by the applicant's Authorized Representative attesting that if the project is awarded funding, at least 80 percent or more of youth participants will be from low-income communities

requiredDocuments.item: Work Plan with schedule, activities, goals, objectives, benchmarks, evaluation, timeframe, resources, and responsibilities (Step Three)
requiredDocuments.quote: Work Plan - Provide an outline of the program schedule and work plan including activities. List goals objectives, benchmarks, evaluation, timeframe, resources, and who is responsible for tasks.

requiredDocuments.item: STD 204 Payee Data Record (nonprofits) or Government Agency Taxpayer ID Form (government agencies) (Step Three)
requiredDocuments.quote: Payee Data Record/Government Agency Taxpayer ID Form - Nonprofit applicants must provide a completed and signed STD 204 Payee Data Record form.

requiredDocuments.item: CEQA documentation (Notice of Exemption, Negative Declaration, or Final EIR, as applicable) before funds are approved (Development Projects)
requiredDocuments.quote: prior to the State approving funding for a proposed project, one of the following must be submitted.
